payload.description:
Purpose: 53d744 wired sinks in-process; 1e09b4 evals are in-process. Remaining 4ddbe1 DoD is live authenticated-use containment: grants and denials must hold on development ThinTurn (HTTP/Dynamo), not only ControlPlane memory.

Acceptance:
- Task grants (tools, origins, recipients, file scopes, egress classes) persist across worker invocations on development.
- Live (or named development exercise) proves a forbidden sink is denied even if the model requests it.
- Allowed read-only / granted work still succeeds.
- desiredCount stays 0. No cdk deploy --all, no production, no 35d86b / PR #26.
payload.title: Persist capability grants on live development ThinTurn
